predictions.reasoning: This market concerns the criminal sentencing outcome of Harvey Weinstein in his New York retrial. It is a personal legal/judicial event with no material connection to any tradable, liquid financial instrument. The Weinstein Company collapsed and was liquidated years ago; there is no listed equity, index, commodity, or currency whose cash flows or risk premia are exposed to the length of his prison sentence. Even broad media or entertainment ETFs have zero fundamental sensitivity to this outcome. Any observed co-movement would be pure noise. There is no forward-looking economic channel from this prediction market to public asset prices.

The correct research conclusion is 'no tradable signal' — direction unclear, near-zero expected move, and very low confidence in any mapping.
